# WiFi Monitor
# https://github.com/qmmughal/wifi-monitor
# llms.txt — Machine-readable project descriptor for LLMs and AI agents

> WiFi Monitor is an open-source, local-first Wi-Fi monitoring and connectivity
> troubleshooting tool: a Python CLI, a loopback-only read-only local API, and a browser
> dashboard. Every value is labelled live, estimated, simulated or unavailable; nothing is fabricated.

## Project

- Name: WiFi Monitor
- Version: 1.3.0-dev
- License: MIT
- Author: Qaiser Mehmood (qmmughal)
- Repository: https://github.com/qmmughal/wifi-monitor
- Language: Python (core, CLI, API), JavaScript (dashboard)

## Implemented

- Live upload/download for any connection type (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, VPN, mobile); per-app data usage and live connections per app
- Wi-Fi adapter health on Windows (driver problem, disabled, radio off)
- Connected Wi-Fi details from the OS: Windows netsh, Linux nmcli/iw, macOS system_profiler (macOS unverified on hardware)
- Nearby access points, channel analysis and recommendations, Wi-Fi generation (4/5/6/6E/7) and width
- Connectivity diagnostics with evidence-based findings; real throughput test (Cloudflare)
- In-memory history with stats, baselines, explainable anomaly alerts, roaming/disconnect events
- Device discovery (passive neighbour table, opt-in sweep), known devices, security observations, signal survey
- Explanations: rule-based, or optional AI (Anthropic SDK or OpenAI-compatible/local), redacted and schema-validated
- Hub + agents with token auth, Prometheus /metrics, MQTT with Home Assistant discovery
- CLI: status, scan, diagnose, speedtest, channels, devices, security, survey, ask, monitor, history, alerts, serve, hub, agent

## Out of scope in this release

- Persistent database (history is in memory by design) and an MCP server.

## Key files

- wifi_monitor/providers/   — per-OS Wi-Fi readers
- wifi_monitor/diagnostics.py — troubleshooter rules
- wifi_monitor/server.py    — local API
- src/                      — dashboard
- docs/CAPABILITIES.md      — what each platform can measure
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md      — design, API endpoints, anomaly rules
- docs/AI.md, docs/DISTRIBUTED.md, docs/CONFIG.md
